title: Avatar Editor (ver. 2025.0)
content: Avatar Settings Avatar Size Measure Arrangement Fitting Suit IK Joint ### ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438255194649) # Avatar Settings ### Objective Adjust the Avatar settings, such as size, measurement, arrangement, fitting suit, and IK settings. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Avatar ▶ Avatar Editor ### Operation 1. Place an Avatar in the 3D window. The Avatar Editor is accessible only when the avatar is in the 3D window. 2. Select the tool/menu indicated above under Location. → Avatar Editor window will appear. 3. Adjust the properties for the properties below. There are separate tabs for Avatar Size, Measure, Arrangement, Fitting Suit, and IK Joint. ### # Avatar Size Avatar size allows you to create a custom-size avatar with your own measurements. The Marvelous Designer Avatar Editor is powered by real body scan data to help you create realistic body shapes, whether you have a complete size specification or not. ### #### **Size:** Option | Description ---|--- Size | Custom / Presets | Select an Avatar size from the presets, or create an avatar with your desired size by inputting detailed measurements. From the dropdown, presets include standard sizing such as Curvy, Straight, Petite Curvy, Petite Straight, Plus Curvy and Plus Straight for women, and size 34 to 52 Standard for men. Additional size measurements can be added and entered in the "Set Details" from the gear icon. Avatar Name (.avs) | Select the Avatar file. Units of measurement | Select from Millimeter, Centimeter, Inch, Feet & Inch. Set Details (gear icon) | By clicking this icon, you can select and activate currently hidden size measurements. When checked on, they will become available in the Size section for editing. Show all Measurements (list icon) | By clicking this icon, you can view active and hidden size measurements that are not displayed in the editor window. If the measure is not checked on in the Set Details it will be visible, but not editable. Width / Height | The Width/Height categories allow you to select what you want the key measures to be for your size, and Marvelous Designer will then automatically generate a proportionate body shape based on these key measures. For example, if Under Bust and Total Height are selected here, circumference, height, and length measures below will be automatically created or slightly adjusted to maintain a proportional body shape. Link (default) | Size editing for Marvelous Designer avatars is algorithm-based, and by default, measures are linked to help you create a proportional body shape based on real human body scan data. Unlink | You can unlink the proportional editing by clicking the icon to deactivate it. When unlinked, any changes to the key Width/Height measurements will not affect the lower measurements. #### **Shape:** Option | Female | Male | Kid | Baby ---|---|---|---|--- Shape | Hand & Head | Hand | O | O | X | X Head | O | O | O | X Crotch | Width | O | O | X | X Volume | O | O | X | X Hip | Dips | O | O | X | X Volume | O | O | X | X Breast | Shape | O | X | X | X Space | O | X | X | X Height | O | X | X | X ### **Custom Avatar Size (recommended workflow)** 1. Go to Avatar > Avatar Editor to open the editor. Load the Avatar *.AVT and ensure it is the version you want to apply your size to. 2. If you are editing from an existing *.AVS file, click the open icon to select your file. When open, the avatar measures will be displayed in the 3D window. Measures that can be moved will appear as black dotted lines, and non-editable measures will be grey dotted lines. 3. Before entering size data in the editor window, ensure the desired values are available. If not, click the Set Details button to add them and Exit to go back to the main editor. For optimal results, it is recommended to activate only the measurements that you have. 4. Once you have your avatar and desired measures, select your key measures for Width / Height and enter your values. It is recommended to keep the default Link option on, but if desired, click the icon to unlink. 5. Now enter your desired measurements in circumference, height, and length. Note that when linked, Marvelous Designer will make slight automatic adjustments to maintain a proportional body shape. ※Note: When developing categories such as gloves, intimates, and headwear, you have additional options to adjust the head, hands, crotch, and bust to suit your needs. 6. Press Save to save your custom Avatar. After creating a custom size, you have the option to save the size only (*.AVS) or as an Avatar (*.AVT). The steps to modify the measurements of an Avatar are the same whether saving an *.AVT or an *.AVS file. The only difference is the way you open the file. #### **File Format** File name | Description ---|--- Avatar (.AVT) | The *.AVT is a Marvelous Designer native format, which contains all the information related to Avatars, including the model, skeleton rig, sizing, pose, motion, accessories, bounding volumes, and arrangement points. Avatar Size (.AVS) | The *.AVS format contains avatar size information. The Avatar file must be loaded before opening an *.AVS size file. The *.AVS format does not contain any avatar, only size information. ※Note: It is not possible to mix *.AVS files between avatars of different versions, age, or gender. The *.AVS file is only compatible with the avatar on which it was originally created. For example, if you created an *.AVS file using a female V2 Avatar, this will only apply to the female V2 Avatar. Saving in .AVS You can connect the folder you saved to your library and click-drag your different sizes on the avatar of your project file. You can open an .AVS file, using the Folder Icon next to Save in the Avatar Editor. Saving in .AVT If you want to add a custom Avatar in the workspace, open from File ▶ Open ▶ Avatar. ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438255194649) # Measure You can use 6 types of avatar tape that allow you to create free measures, circumference, linear, and height measurements. Please see the [**Measure manual**](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358154578585-Avatar-Measure-above-ver-10) for additional Measure information. All added measurements can be viewed and renamed in the Measure tab. ※Note: The difference between ‘Basic’ and ‘Surface’ is whether the measure will follow the curvature of the avatar's body or follow a direct line around the widest points. The Basic Tapes are most akin to methods of measuring the body with soft measuring tape, whereas ‘Surface’ will measure along the curved surface of the body. #### **Measure:** Option | Description ---|--- Measure | Name | The default name appears after creating a new measure. Double-click on the text to rename. Delete | Delete the selected Measure. ※Note: You can also use the Edit Measurement tool to select the Tape Measure in the 3D Window and hit either the Backspace or Delete key. Fit to Avatar | Re-fit the measurements when changing its Pose or loading another Avatar's joints. Open | Open a *.MEA file created with other Marvelous Designer Avatars. Save | Save the measurements in *.MEA format to open with other Marvelous Designer Avatars. ※Note:.MEA files should be applied to the same model in the same version. Measurement Type | Toggle the Measurement Type between Basic and Surface to update the type without needing to recreate the measurement. Measurement Information | Measurement Information given is either Tape or Circumference. Basic Length | Check the value when measured with the Basic Measurement tool. Surface Length | Check the value when measured with the Surface Measurement tool. Show | Toggle on or off to show or hide the selected measurement in the 3D Window. Show Length | Toggle on or off to show or hide the selected measurement in the 3D Window. ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438255194649) # Arrangement Edit, add or delete any of the Bounding Volumes or Arrangement Points in the Arrangement tab. Please see the [Arrangement manual](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/sections/47114831810969) for additional information on how to use Bounding Volumes and Arrangement Points. You can rename any Bounding Volume and Arrangement Point with "NAME_1_L", "NAME_1_R" to maintain symmetry. All arrangement points apart from the Avatar's body are symmetrically set by default. #### **Bounding Volume:** Option | Description ---|--- Board | Name | You can double-click to rename the default name. Add | A new Bounding Volume called “PAN” will be added at the bottom of the list. Delete | Deleted the selected Bounding Volume Reset Bounding Volumes | Reset to the original position Open | Open a pre-saved *.PAN file Save | Save the created *.PAN file to use with other avatars. Joint Name 0 | Set the beginning location of the Joint (X-ray) Joint Name 1 | Set the end location of the Joint (Show Avatar Joint) Height | Set the height Radius X (mm) | Set the horizontal radius Radius Y (mm) | Set the vertical radius Hands/Feet | Toggle on to extend BV's length to Avatar's hands or feet, respectively #### **Point:** Option | Description ---|--- Placement | Name | You can double-click to rename the default name. Add | A new arrangement point named “Arrangement Point” will be created at the bottom of the list. Note that the point is unassigned by default, and you will need to select the BV and X Y positions in the steps below. Delete | Delete the selected Arrangement Point. Open | Open an *.ARR file; this can be used to apply Arrangement points to an *.OBJ avatar. Save | Save as an *.ARR file and open on another Avatar. Note: Some readjustment may be needed when applying to another avatar. Arrangement BV | Selects the Bounding Volume where the Arrangement Point is to be placed. X | Moves the Arrangement Point left and right. Y | Moves the Arrangement Point up and down. Offset | Sets the distance between the Avatar and the Arrangement Point. Wrap Direction | Wrapping can be set to up or down and will determine the direction of the pattern wrap when placed on the Arrangement Point. ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438255194649) # Fitting Suit 1. Draw lines on the avatar according to the indicated position below. 2. Create the circumference line on the avatar's position following the image. • The pattern of the fitting suit is displayed. • The circumference line on both sides is automatically created symmetrically. 3. After creating all the circumference lines, click the Drape Fitting Suit button. • The fitting suit is draped. Adjust the fitting in the 3D window if needed. Option | Description ---|--- Fitting Suit | Auto Create Fitting Suit | Click this icon to create a fitting suit automatically. If the avatar is not created properly, we recommend creating it manually. Create Symmetric Tape | Toggle on and off to create the draw line symmetric or not symmetric. Delete | Delete the drawing line. Reset | All drawing lines will be deleted. Save | Save as an *.AVT file. **![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438255194649) ** # IK Joint Use IK joint mapping with various avatars to achieve natural movement while ensuring seamless compatibility for motions and poses across all avatars. The avatar must have properly defined joint points. Rigging must include key joints such as shoulders, elbows, wrists, pelvis, knees, and ankles. Joints are categorized into required and optional, and you must map all required joints to ensure proper IK setup. ※ Note: The FBX file must not contain joints with duplicate names, and IK mapping may not apply correctly for creatures or quadruped avatars with non-human structures. Operation | Description ---|--- Open / Save | You can manage the IK data mapped to the avatar as a file. Click Open / Save icon at the top right to open or save IK data as a .iks file. ※Note: IK files are only compatible between avatars that have been mapped. Auto Mapping | If the avatar meets the following conditions, click Auto Mapping at the top right to apply automatic mapping. • If each joint name of the avatar matches that of the Marvelous Designer avatar. • If the avatar is from one of the following platforms: Daz 3D, Adobe Mixamo, Reallusion Character Creator, or Unreal Engine MetaHuman. Set T-Pose | Set the avatar in a T-pose to ensure proper compatibility with Marvelous Designer avatar pose and motion files apply correctly. Adjust the avatar’s joints directly to a T-pose using the gizmo in the 3D window. If the avatar is already in a T-pose, this step can be skipped. Click Set T-Pose button. Reset Pose | If T-Pose is set correctly, this button activates, allowing you to check the Set T-pose when clicked. After adjusting the pose during IK mapping, click this button to revert the avatar to the set T-pose. ****
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for adjusting Avatar settings in Marvelous Designer, including size, measurement, arrangement, fitting suit, and IK joint configurations to create realistic and customized avatars for 3D design.

title: Avatar: Register Pose/Motion
content: ### Objective Register the motion from FBX file as the motion files compatible with Marvelous Designer Template avatars. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Avatar ▶ Register Pose/Motion ### ### Operation 1. Click the Main Menu » Avatar » **Register Pose/Motion**. → A popup window with message "All avatars and garments in 3D Window will be deleted. Do you want to proceed?" Click **Proceed** Button if you want to continue. 2. In the Register Pose/Motion window, select the type to register, either **Pose** or **Motion**. 3. Open the FBX file by clicking on the **folder![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438377062425)** button. 4. Select the Gender of the compatible CLO avatar and select the Shoe Type for female. 5. For motion, switch to Animation mode to play loaded motion as needed. 6. Click the **Save** button to save as the Pose(*.pos) or Motion(*.mtn) file. ### Register Pose/Motion window Type | Pose | Register and save as pose (*.pos) file type. ---|---|--- Motion | Register and save as motion (*.mtn) file type. File (FBX) | Select the FBX file with animation to use for registering. Option Gender | Female | Register the pose / Motion to female template avatar. Shoe Type | Select between **Heels** and **flat** shoe types. This setting will affect heel joint rotation of the character. Male | Register the pose / Motion to male template avatar. Kid | Register the pose / Motion to kid template avatar. Region (for motion *.mtn file type only) | Entire | Register the animation from the FBX file to entire region. Play Only | Register the animation from the FBX file to set play region only. Current Frame | Register the animation from the FBX file to current frame. ###
content_description: This webpage guides users through the process of registering motion or pose data from an FBX file for use with Marvelous Designer template avatars.

title: Fabric Style Window
content: ### Objective Add and organize fabric style and apply it to the garment. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Fabric Style Tab (ver. 2025.0) Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ Object Browser ▶ Fabric Style Tab (ver. 2025.0) ### ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438423459353) Operation #### Open Fabric Asset Library 1. Open the Fabric Library tab in Location. 2. Select the Asset Library icon ![Asset Library.svg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438423651097) to open the default location for Fabric Style assets in the New Library Window. #### Add Fabric Style & Apply 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. 2. Click +Add at the top right. Or add a Fabric file by dragging it to the Fabric tab or on the 3D garment. → A Fabric style is added. Click Copy at the top right. → A Fabric style is duplicated. 3. Drag the style to the 3D/2D pattern and apply it. Or after selecting a pattern first, click the Assign button to the right of the Fabric tab or Fabric style. → The Fabric is applied to the pattern. 4. By clicking the left square icon located on the right of the Fabric name, you can toggle texture mapping type between Unified Map / Texture Repeat. Unified Map: Displays textures based on the pattern layout in the UV map. Texture Repeat: Repeatedly displays the texture across the pattern. 5. Click the Plus icon located on the left of the bin icon, to add prints to your Fabric. Select your print image and open. You can still change the Unified Map / Texture Repeat by clicking the icon from process #4. Adjust the Material Property Editor. #### Group Setting (ver. 2025.0) 1. To set Fabric Groups, Click the Create New Folder button at the top left of the Fabric tab. → A new folder group is created. 2. Click the Add Fabric or Open Fabric Files buttons on the right side of the group to load the Fabric file. → A Fabric style is added or opened to the group. 3. Click the Edit Folder Name button on the left of the group to edit the name. 4. Click and Drag the Fabric to different groups. → Right click on the Fabric, select Drop as Copying, to drop the fabric to the other group folder to copy. This allows to keep the Fabric in the original group folder while making a copied Fabric in the new group folder. → Right click on the Fabric, select Drop as Moving, to drop the fabric to the other group folder.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for adding, organizing, and applying fabric styles to garments using the Fabric Style Tab in the Object Browser (ver. 2025.0).

title: Project File (*.ZPrj) Open/Save
content: ### Objective Compress the various files used for Garment creation into one file, and save it. ※ Note: #### Files included in Project (*.zprj) files * *.avt file, with all Avatar-related data [Avatar, Accessories, Arrangement Bounding Volumes, Arrangement Points, Avatar Size, Poses] * If there are multiple Avatars, they are all saved within the Project file (ver2.3.0). * *.zpac file, containing all Garment-related data (3D Garments, 2D Patterns, Fabrics, subsidiary Materials) * *.anm file, if an Animation has been recorded * Any 3D environment settings (Wind, Light, Ground, Background Image/Color, Scenes/Props) * Simulation options set by the user (ver2.3.0). ### Location #### Open Project File Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Open ▶ Project (Ctrl+O) #### Save/Save Over Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Save Project (Ctrl+S) #### Save As Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Save As ▶ Project (Ctrl+Shift+S) #### New Project (ver. 12.1) Main Menu ▶ File ▶ New Project (Ctrl+N) ### Operation #### Open Project File 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Open ▶ Project (Ctrl+O) → The Open File window opens. 2. Select the desired file and click OK to load the file. ※ Note: Double-click the Project file *.zprj or drag and drop it onto the 3D window to open it. 3. Apply any detailed settings, then click on the OK button Load Type | Open a new project file or Add the file additionally. If you add additional files, you can set the position of the object in the X, Y, and Z Axis. ---|--- Object | Enables the selective import of object types included in the project file. * Garment * Avatar * 3D State * Custom View * Scene and Props * Display Settings #### Save Over Project File 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Save Project (Ctrl+S) → The original Project file is overwritten. #### Save Project File 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Save As ▶ Project (Ctrl+Shift+S) → The Open File window opens. 2. Select a location to save the Garment file. 3. Enter the Project name into the File Name tab and press Save to save the file. → A Project file *.zprj will be created along with its thumbnail image. #### New Project (ver. 12.1) 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ New Project (Ctrl+N) → The existing file will be closed and a new “Untitled” project file will be created.
content_description: This webpage provides comprehensive instructions for compressing and saving garment creation files into a single project file for efficient management and organization.

title: Seamline Property (ver. 2025.0)
content: ### Objective Adjust Seamline properties such as line types, tension, sublayers, topstitch, puckering, and 3D Seamline Normal Maps to render a realistic Garment. ### ### Location Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ Edit Sewing (B) 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Sewing (B) ### Operation 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location. 2. Click on any point or segment of the Sewing Line to display the Property Editor. Properties | Description ---|--- Seam | Open | Open a Sewing Style Preset File (*.ssp). Save | The current properties can be saved as a Sewing Style Preset File (.ssp) type file. Information | Name | Set the name of the currently selected sewing line. Sewing Line Type | Turned (Off) | Fold Strength | The intensity of the fold is able to be set by adjusting the value of Fold Strength. The higher the value, the closer the fold is to the set angle. When a jacket and its lining are sewn together, the sewn area inflates due to the default sewing angle and intensity values. In this case, set the Fold Strength to 0 to flatten the sewn boundaries. Fold Angle | 180° represents a flat state. The internal line is folded towards the front of the pattern as the fold angle is closer to 0˚ and is folded into the back of the pattern as the angle is closer to 360˚. Turned (On) | Sew two layers of pattern flatly. The Fold Strength and Fold Angle settings cannot be adjusted. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438049347737) Tension | When the 3D garment is expressed as being stretched more than the actual garment, adjust the Tension of Sewing Line. Same as the actual real life concept, Tension is applied based on the short or long side with the Ease and Stretch options. Sewing Line Type | Ease | When the seam lengths differ, this type adds a slight allowance, resulting in a relatively soft sewing tension. Stretch | When the seam lengths differ, this type does not add any allowance, resulting in a more precise and higher sewing tension. Strength | Increase or decrease the strength of the sewing tension by entering the value. The result may vary depending on the Strength even with the same Ratio value. Ratio | Adjust the sewing tension's ratio to express varying drape effects by different sewing methods. Set Sublayer | Assign orders to the Sewing Lines on a Pattern that folds on itself such as seam allowances and pleats, to increase simulation stability. Reverse Direction | Swap the order of the Sewing Line and the Sewed Line. Sublayer | Decide which side of the fabric is attached to the fixed Sewing Line, Back or Front. Topstitch | Name | Rename the Topstitch. Topstitch Property | Change the style of the selected Topstitch. Extend | When the start or end point of a Topstitch does not reach or sticks out of the Pattern outline, extend it to fit to the Pattern. Corner | Curved | Set the Topstitch corner type to extend the stitch more smoothly at corners. Right Angled | Set the Topstitch to be a right angle in the corner of the pattern. Smooth | Set it to continue naturally if the edge of the Topstitch is broken. Offset | Set the Z Offset of the Topstitch. Placement | Seam A | Topstitch will be shown only on Seam A. Seam B | Topstitch will be shown only on Seam B. Seam Both | Topstitch will be shown on both sides. Puckering | Name | Rename the Puckering. Puckering Property | Change the style of the selected Topstitch. Extend | Extend the start/endpoint of the puckering to the 2D pattern outline. Offset | Offset (mm) | Adjust the distance between the puckering and the pattern outline. Include the Puckering Width in Offset or not if needed. Z Offset (mm) | Adjust the distance between the Z-axis and a pattern piece. Placement | Seam A | Puckering will be shown only on Seam A. Seam B | Puckering will be shown only on Seam B. Seam Both | Puckering will be shown on both sides. 3D Seamline | Plain Seam | Normal Map | Select an image to be used as the Normal Map. Intensity | Adjust the intensity of the Normal Map applied to the seamline. Thickness (mm) | Adjust the thickness of the Normal Map applied to the seamline. Directional | Placement | Select Seam A or Seam B for the placement of the seamline. Normal Map | Select an image to be used as the Normal Map. Intensity | Adjust the intensity of the Normal Map applied to the seamline. Thickness (mm) | Adjust the thickness of the Normal Map applied to the seamline.
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for adjusting seamline properties in garment design, enabling users to create realistic and customizable sewing effects.

title: ZIPPER: Zipper Tape Properties
content: ### Objective Modify the Zipper tape properties. ### ### Location 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ▶ Zipper Tape (Click On Zipper Tape)▶ Property Editor ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ▶ Zipper Tape (Click On Zipper Tape)▶ Property Editor → The properties of the selected Zipper Tape appear in the Property Editor. 2. Modify the Zipper Tape properties based on the available options below: **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- Name | Rename the Zipper Tape. Line Length | Edit the length of the Zipper teeth. Preset (ver. 2025.0) | Set the preset of the Zipper from Custom, Plastic_01, Plastic_02, Metal, Nylon, Reverse_Nylon, Invisible. Texture (ver. 2025.0) | Set the Teeth type to Texture or OBJ. Size (ver.11) | Set the size of the Zipper. Teeth Width | Enter directly the width of the Zipper to adjust. Total Width | Adjust the Tape width of the Zipper. Width | Set the width of the Zipper Tape. The texture image changes based on the width entered. Thickness | Set the Zipper Tape Thickness. Particle Distance | Adjust zipper tape's Particle Distance. Fasten Zipper | Zip or unzip the Zipper. Fold | Adjust the Strength of the fold for Sewing between the Zipper and Pattern. Material | Set the Material Type, Texture, Color and Opacity of the Zipper Teeth and Tape. Physical Property | Adjust physical properties to the selected zipper teeth.
content_description: Modify the properties of the Zipper Tape in the Property Editor to customize its appearance and functionality.

title: Buttonhole Style Window (ver. 2025)

title: Compatible File Format
content: ### File | Format | Import | Export | Detail ---|---|---|---|--- 3D | FBX | *.fbx | O | O | File contains Mesh, Material, Joint, Animation, and Camera information. *Only Joint that was imported as FBX to Marvelous Designer can be exported as FBX. OBJ | *.obj | O | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Primarily used for importing Avatar and related sources into the program. Alembic | *.abc | O | O | Is an interchange file format for computer graphics that saves both vertex and animation information. ※ Mac export (ver. 5.1.431) Open COLLADA | *.dae | O | X | This file can be exported from other 3D softwares such as 3ds Max, Maya and used. These files contain geometry and material, in addition to rigging, skinning, and animation data When exporting OpenCOLLADA files from 3DS Max or Maya, install the “OpenCOLLADA plugin ([http://www.opencollada.org](http://www.opencollada.org/)) and export to use the avatar USD | *.usd | O | O | File contains Mesh, Material, Joint, Animation, Camera, and Scene Layout information. Serves as a universal interchange format for 3D content across various applications and platforms. For more information, please see the [USD file compatibility page.](USD%20file%20Compatibility) USDZ (ver. 2025.0) | *.usdz | X | O | File contains Mesh, Material, Joint, Animation, Camera, and Scene Layout information. It is a compressed package format that combines all 3D assets into a single file. Primarily used for AR/VR applications and interactive 3D content. Animation Cache | *.mc *.pc2 *.mdd | O | O | Is the vertex animation data. It is possible to take animations made in Marvelous Designer to 3DSMax or Maya in point cache format. LXO | *.lxo | X | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Used to export Apparel/Avatar information to Modo in the LXO file format. 3D Snapshot | *.png | - | O | Ability to save single views of the 3D window in the PNG file format. 2D | Texture | *.jpg, *.png, etc. | O | O | Textures inserted into garments, use image textures in formats such as JPG, PNG, TIF, and PSD. Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, bmp, wbmp, psd, ico, tga, tif, tiff, gif, mng, jng, dds, hdr, koa, lbm, iff, pbm, pcd, pcx, pgm, ppm, ras, cut, xmb, xpm, sgi, g3, exr, j2k, jp2, pfm, pict, pct) Substance | *.sbsar | O | - | File contains procedural texture information with adjustable parameters. The separate channels of a Substance material can be baked and exported (color, normal, metalness, roughness, opacity)

title: Avatar IK Joint Mapping (2025.0)
content: YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrfygGSENOY ### Objective Streamline IK joint mapping for various avatars to achieve natural movement while ensuring seamless compatibility for motions and poses across all avatars. The avatar must have properly defined joint points. Rigging must include key joints such as shoulders, elbows, wrists, pelvis, knees, and ankles. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Avatar ▶ Avatar Editor ▶ IK Joint tab ### IK Joint Mapping ※ Note: The FBX file must not contain joints with duplicate names, and IK mapping may not apply correctly for creatures or quadruped avatars with non-human structures. Joints are categorized into required and optional, and you must map all required joints to ensure proper IK setup. ![IK.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438084949529) For optional joints, we recommend mapping those indicated in the image if they are present in the avatar to achieve more accurate results. ## ![IK_Optional.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438039415193) **1\. Auto Mapping** If the avatar meets the following conditions, click the Auto Mapping at the top right to apply automatic mapping. • If each joint name of the avatar matches that of the Marvelous Designer avatar. • If the avatar is from one of the following platforms: Daz 3D, Adobe Mixamo, Reallusion Character Creator, or Unreal Engine MetaHuman. **2\. Manual Mapping** 1\. Click the desired item from the image or list in the IK Mapping tab, then click the joint to be mapped on the avatar in the 3D Window. * Alternatively, you can first click the joint on the avatar and then click an item from the tab. 2\. When Symmetry Mapping option at the top right is turned on, the corresponding joint on the opposite side is automatically mapped. Note that both sides must be named as follows: Left_/Right_, L_ / R_,Left / Right,_L / _R,_Left / _Right. 3\. Once all mapping is set up, adjust IK Pose. ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438053745049) ### Set Pose Set the avatar in a T-pose to ensure proper compatibility with Marvelous Designer avatar pose and motion files apply correctly. 1\. Adjust the avatar’s joints directly to a T-pose using the gizmo in the 3D window. * If the avatar is already in a T-pose, this step can be skipped. 2\. Click the Set T-Pose at the top right. **※ Note:** • If set correctly, the Reset Pose activates, allowing you to check the set T-pose when clicked. • After adjusting the pose during IK mapping, click the Reset Pose button to revert the avatar to the set T-pose. **Open/Save** You can manage the IK data mapped to the avatar as a file. * Click Open/Save at the top right to open or save IK data as a .iks file. * IK files are only compatible between avatars that have been mapped.
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide for streamlining IK joint mapping for avatars in order to ensure natural movement and compatibility across various models in Marvelous Designer.

title: Set Fabric Textures
content: ### Objective Represents the pattern or texture of the fabric. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Fabric Tab ### Operation 1. Click the menu at the indicated location. 2. Select a fabric item. → Fabric properties appear in the Property Editor. 3. Set the basic material by referring to the table below. #### PBR (Default) Option | Description ---|--- Texture Repeat Type (Ver. 10) / Texture Mapping (Ver. 11) | Repeat | Repeatedly display the texture on the pattern. Unified Map | Display the texture based on the pattern layout of the UV map. [Repeat UV Settings] * Repeat U: Size the texture based on U direction. * Repeat V: Size the texture based on V direction. The number 1 means that the texture is repeated once between 0-1 of the UV map. Type | Set the appropriate Material Type. ※Note: If garment is created in Marvelous Designer or Downloaded from CONNECT, the fabric type may display as * (Read-only) Fabric Type with the same name in Marvelous Designer. However, since there is no render engine in Marvelous Designer, the fabric display in 3D window will not be accurate. Base Color (ver. 2025.0) | Color | Select your chosen color from the color wheel or leave as (None) Base Color Map | Recolor | Remove the default color to apply other colors while retaining the pattern or texture. Desaturate | It desaturates the color of the graphics. Set the Shadow Intensity and Shadow Brightness. Switch | Easily and quickly switch the color of solid fabric to a new one without losing the accuracy of the chosen color. ![Switch Color.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47358364190105) ※Note: For consistent results, the Base Color Map should contain 1 color. If the Base Color Map contains multiple colors, users may experience unexpected or unintended results. Texture | Click the explore button and apply a texture image from Library/Folder ※Note: Click both back and side tabs and deactivate 'Use Same Materials as Front' to apply different materials to other faces of the pattern. Remove Texture Color | Remove the default color to apply other colors while retaining the pattern or texture. Normal Map | Apply Normal Map image to express uneven texture more realistically. Automatic | When a texture is applied, Normal Map is generated by adjusting the Intensity. Higher intensity makes the embossed detail raised off the surface, the lower intensity makes the details lower than the surface. Manual | Click the explore or apply the Normal Map image from the Library/Folder ※Note: Use the normal map image made with the exclusive tool to achieve an accurate normal effect. Also, add a normal map that is different with texture in order to create an extra pattern of surface. Displacement Map (ver.11) | Express thickness or bumpiness of fabrics or textures. As displacement maps are grey-scaled, their height is determined by the level of darkness of the grey color. ※ Note: * Increase the image resolution and apply the Gaussian Blur effect to express the texture smoothly. * Displacement map's minimum particle distance value is now 0.01 mm to allow for greater mesh density for displacement map (Ver. 2024.1) Amount | Adjust the maximum height of the displacement map. The white area of the displacement map shows the maximum height. Shift | Adjust the distance between the displacement map and the garment surface Clipping | Adjust to delete all geometries below the Clipping value. Particle Distance | Adjust the Particle Distance of newly created meshes. ※ Note: As more memory is used for lower Particle Distance, it is recommended not to set the Particle Distance below 1 for a wide area. Keep Continuity | Extend the adjacent face to eliminate the boundary line. ※ Note: Only applicable to Welded OBJs. Color | Express each of the fabrics in various colorways Opacity | Adjust Opacity to create sheer fabric. ※Note: When you apply opacity to texture, change Garment Rendering Style as Thick Textured Surface. Alpha Map (ver. 10) | Express level of transparency using a grayscale image map RGB Mode | The encoded map with alpha value in RGB channel. Alpha Mode | The encoded map with alpha value in alpha channel. Roughness | Intensity | Edit fabric gloss by adjusting Intensity of the Roughness Map | Edit fabric gloss by adding and modifying Roughness Map. Map | Select the Browse button next to the Map option to add a Roughness Map to the selected Fabric style. Map Intensity | Adjust the Map's Intensity. The range of Roughness map intensity was enlarged in (ver. 2024.2) Invert | Select to invert the gloss of the fabric. When this option is selected, the shinny part becomes dull and vice-versa. To use Specular Maps provided in below ver. 6, check this option. Reflection Intensity | Greater the Reflection Intensity value is, more reflective than the material or fabric is and vice-versa. Metalness (ver. 10) | Adjust metallic level. Higher value makes the surface more metallic. Metalness Map (ver. 10) | Partially express metallics using a grayscale image. The white parts of the map appear metallic. ※Note: * When working with Metalness Map, control Roughness Intensity and Reflection Intensity level that are suitable for the metallic texture. (e.g. Roughness Intensity 10, Reflection Intensity 90) * For the non-metallic areas(matte), assign the same metalness map to Roughness Map, and turn on Invert. #### Substance (ver. 10) Set the file format as Substance at the right menu of Material, you can use SBSAR file of Substance which is the main application of physical based rendering. To get a better rendering result for substance materials, enable High-Quality Render on 3D window. Properties | Description ---|--- Substance File | Import SBSAR file by clicking 'Explore' or, download SBSAR file by clicking 'Go to Substance Source'. * SBSAR file can be imported by Object Browser> Right-click on Fabric item. Preset | Choose the preset of SBSAR. Resolution | Adjust the image resolution of SBSAR. Custom Properties | Edit the properties of SBSAR. ※Note: Custom Properties are different depending on the property of the file. Refer to the [Substance Manual](https://docs.substance3d.com/home) for more detailed information. ※ Note: * Clicking on a Fabric from the Fabric List is going to highlight the Patterns where the Fabric is being applied to, in the 3D/2D window. * Clicking on a Pattern in the 3D or 2D window is going to highlight the Fabric where it is being applied to, in the Object Browser ▶ Fabric Tab.
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for users to select and customize fabric patterns and textures within the Object Browser's Fabric Tab, detailing operational steps and available properties for enhanced material rendering.

title: Can I cancel my subscription?
content: #### _*** The annual license is only a one-time purchase license, and it won't be auto-renewed.**_ ## **[Personal Monthly License Holder]** Yes, if you're using a recurring subscription license, you can cancel your recurring subscription on [My account > License page. ](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/license)(Click "Stop Subscription") ![mceclip0 \(2\).png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47448309723161) You can either choose**"Cancel Subscription"** or **"Pause Subscription"** of up to 6 months. _* Even if you cancel your subscription, you can continue using it for the remaining period until the license expires under the "**cancel scheduled** " status. Once the license expires, it will be completely canceled, and no additional charges will be incurred._ _* For annual license subscribers, the "Stop Subscription" button is not visible because the license does not renew automatically._ ## **[Personal Trial License Holder]** ![trial.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438478664473) You can cancel the trial by clicking the**Cancel Trial** button. No charges will be applied after the trial expires. _* Even if you cancel your Trial, you can continue using it for the remaining period until the trial expires under the "**cancel scheduled** " status. Once the license expires, it will be completely canceled, and no additional charges will be incurred._ #### **Personal License Status Details:** ✅ Active Your license is currently active, and payments are being processed as expected. You can continue using Marvelous Designer until the scheduled pause date. 🚫 Paused Your license remains active, but payments have been stopped, and Marvelous Designer is no longer accessible. 📅 Cancel Scheduled Your license is active, and payments are being processed, but a cancellation has been scheduled. title: Enterprise Account & License Management Guide
content: ## Account ### **Company ID - License ID Relationship diagram** ![Company ID.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/55759226352153) _**Difference between License ID and Company ID**_ * _**Company ID:**_ Your "Company ID" is an administrator account that can manage "License IDs" owned by the license manager or purchaser. Through your License Admin Page on our website, you can create, delete and change the password of any "License ID" that belongs to the "Company ID". Purchasing and assigning a license to an "License ID" are authorities only available to a “Company ID”. A “Company ID” cannot contain any type of license on its own and therefore cannot be used to log into the software. * _**License ID:**_ An "License ID" is an account for actual users which can hold licenses and is used to log in to the software. An "License ID" cannot be used to purchase a license through our website. An License ID can only be used to modify some of the information on its account page (i.e. Name, Country, Territory, Region, or Profile Photo) ID Type | **License Purchase** | **License Account Admin Access** | **Store Item Purchase** | **Log In To Software** ---|---|---|---|--- **Company ID** | **O** | **O** | **O** | **X** **License ID** | **X** | **X** | **X** | **O** *** Note** In the case of Enterprise Users who have created their IDs before the deployment of the ‘Company ID - License ID’ structure, you would already have the Company ID designated by us. In order for you to find your Company ID, please [contact us](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/support/contact). ### **How Can I Manage My Licenses?** To manage your licenses, you will first need to login with your Company ID, at the page below. * [Account Login Page](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/member/signin) On “License Account Admin” you can view all License IDs you have created, upcoming expiration dates, delete/add users, purchases licenses, view active users, etc. You can access License Account Admin upon after the login, by clicking on your profile icon. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438023097369)![image \(5\).png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47437990997657) _(sample image)_ On your “Dashboard”, you can view weekly average access to licenses, how many times licenses were used, how long do users spend on the software on average and etc. _*Denied access_ Denied Access refers to concurrent access being exceeded by users. For example, if you have 10 licenses, your concurrent access will be for 10 seats. If you are sharing the 10 licenses among 20 people, this feature lets you know that one of the 10 individuals will have to log out if another user needs access, or it may be time for you to purchase additional seats. The data is only valid for the network (floating type) license holders. The contact information is also provided on the left bottom of the screen for regional managers. Regional managers can help you with how to use the License Management services, and answer any questions. Based on the location you have set for your account, you will have different regional managers. If the listed regional managers are out of office, please feel free to contact md.bizdev@marvelousdesigner.com to reach out to the entire business development team. ### **How Do I Know What Licenses I Have and What Can I Do With Them?** Click on the “License” tab on your left menu which will bring you to this page. ![image \(6\).png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47437977588249) _(sample image)_ **Filter section** In this section, you can search License IDs or an email address to quickly look for the License ID you are looking for, set to view active and expired licenses, perpetual/monthly/yearly/trial licenses and different versions of licenses. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47437977795481) _(sample image)_ **License detail section** In this section, you can see every License ID under your Company ID. You can view information such as the email address attached to the License ID, plan type, license type, license count, current software version, and expiration dates. You can also directly add/extend your existing seats, or purchase a new license through this menu option. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438040393497) _(sample image)_ **Add/extend option** You can add another license to the same License ID or extend the license period before the period ends. Both actions can only be done before the license expires. **New license option** New License option allows you to renew licenses past the expiration date. This action can only be done after the license expires. **Trade-In option** Perpetual license is eligible for our 'Trade-In' service, which is to convert perpetual license to annual type. Please refer the link below for more detailed information on this. * [Trade-In Policy](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/support/news?postId=233762c17aa04616bb0367f0f9561371) **License ID (End User) detail section** Clicking the individual License ID (End User) from the previous image on the left hand side, will lead you to the single License ID detail page. In this page, you can manage License IDs by viewing the user details, your password for the user, the email address and the IP address when the license is being used at corporate premises. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438008453657) _(sample image)_ ### **What Else Can I Expect from License Account Admin page?** **User Pool** Within User Pool feature we provide, licenses are now much flexible in terms of management. Please read a separate manual followed by the link below, for better understanding of the usability around this feature. * [**User Pool Manual**](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358149827609) **Invoice** In the invoice section, you can view your past orders and invoices. You can also add and edit your billing address within this section.
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for managing Company IDs and License IDs, detailing their distinct roles, functionalities, and access within the license management system.

title: Refund Policy for Cancellations
content: ### **ESSENTIALS** ## **Target:****Personal Accounts** ## **Plan:****Monthly** ## **Situation:** When a **trial automatically converts** to a Monthly subscription ### **POLICY** To prevent unexpected charges and reduce inconvenience for our users, we provide a 24-hour grace period right after your trial converts to a Monthly plan. Within this time frame, you can cancel and get a full refund if you decide not to continue. Cancel within 24 hours → Eligible for a full refund. * Your subscription will be terminated immediately. * You will lose access to the service right away. Cancel after 24 hours → No refund. * You will retain access until the end of the current billing cycle. * Direct purchase of Monthly (without trial) → No refund policy applies. ### **HOW TO CANCEL AND GET REFUNDS** 1. Go to License Tab of My Page and click [Refund available in n hours]. **![selfRefund1.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/50938689639449)** 2. Proceed with Cancel Subscription. **Start Cancel Subscription** **![selfRefund2.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/50938662660249)** **Check Refund Information** **![selfRefund3.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/50938662662553)** **Survey** **![selfRefund4.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/50938689647385)** 3\. Check your email to confirm your cancellation. **![selfRefund5.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/50938662666777)** If you purchase a Monthly plan directly without a trial, the refund policy does not apply. In this case, canceling your subscription will only stop the auto-renewal, and you will still retain access to the service until the end of your current billing cycle.

title: Remove Device from Marvelous Designer website
content: ### Applicable for: Marvelous Designer 10 and under * From **Marvelous Designer 11** onward, licenses are automatically deactivated when the software is closed. The __Remove Device__ option is no longer required. Problems * Worked with Marvelous Designer on the office computer and tried to log in to Marvelous Designer with a home computer, but it says it is already in use. * Tried to log in to Marvelous Designer on a new computer, but it says another computer is already in use. * Worked on the desktop and tried to log in to the laptop, but it says it is already in use. How to Remove Device 1) Log in to the Marvelous Designer website and go to My account. [https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage ](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage) 2) Check the Account tab. 3) Scroll down and click the "Remove" button next to the Remove Device. Read more * When the Marvelous Designer software is running, the Remove button does not appear on the Marvelous Designer website. * After the Marvelous Designer software has completely quit, the Remove button is displayed on the Marvelous Designer website. * If you exit by selecting "Log out" or "Deactivation" in the software, the Remove button will not appear on the Marvelous Designer website. * Depending on the region, network, and Marvelous Designer server status, the Remove button may be delayed up to 15 minutes. * Remove Device does not cancel your Marvelous Designer license or subscription.

title: Account Integration FAQ User Guide (CLO-SET account)
content: ## **Objective** **Access all CLO Virtual Fashion services using a single email account.** This FAQ will cover the updates and changes to login methods for **Marvelous Designer** **Personal** & **Student** license account types. This change will NOT affect Enterprise & Academic account types at this time. Please check the general [FAQ](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us) if you have questions about the account merging process (CLO-SET accounts). ## ## **Details** ### 1) Change in sign-in method **Effective date on** the release of Marvelous Designer 2024.0. **What does this cover?** Marvelous Designer website / Software version 2024.0 and above. | **Software Version** **(12,11,10 and below)** | **Software Version** **Above 2024.0** ---|---|--- **How to login** | **Existing User ID & Password** | **CLO-SET Account & Password ** #### ### 2) How do I get a “CLO-SET Account & Password” if I have an existing Marvelous Designer ID? Check out our detailed step-by-step guide **[HERE](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261710929177)**. #### ### 3) What is the difference between a CLO-SET account and my previous Marvelous Designer ID? With your old Marvelous Designer ID you had to have multiple logins to access all of the CLO Virtual Fashion (CVF) products and services. Now with one CLO-SET account you can access all CLO Virtual Fashion services without additional logins. #### ### 4) I am using a perpetual license for Marvelous Designer. Do I have to merge my account? You do not have to If you are only logging into Marvelous Designer software only. If you want to access the Marvelous Designer website, you will need to follow the on screen prompt to merge your account into a CLO-SET account. Or you can check out our detailed step-by-step guide **[HERE](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261710929177)**. #### ### 5) Can I still use my Perpetual License after I merge my account with CLO-SET?** ** Yes**!** All data/assets/subscription information associated with your pre-existing account will remain the same. You can download your software licenses from the same location, in “[My Account](https://marvelousdesigner.com/mypage)” page. #### ### 6) How do I login to CLO / Marvelous Designer / Jinny after I merge my account? You can login to CLO / Marvelous Designer / Jinny with your CLO-SET Account & Password. #### ### 7) I have a subscription license for Marvelous Designer and I like to use an older version than 2024.0. Do I have to use a different sign in or can I use the CLO-SET account? * If you have an old installer on your device and you have access to versions below 12: Use the older login method. Login to the installed version you wish to use with your User ID & Password (same as before). * For 2024.0 and above: you can log in to all CLO Virtual Fashion product (CLO/Marvelous Designer/CONNECT/CLO-SET) websites and software with your CLO-SET account. ### 8) I bought items from the Marvelous Designer Store (before CONNECT existed). Where can I download my purchased items? All items purchased from the Marvelous Designer Store will be downloadable from [CONNECT's My Page > Purchase](https://connect.clo-set.com/mypage/purchase) tab. *This applies to purchases made after April 28, 2020 on the Marvelous Designer store page. If you have purchases made before April 28, 2020, those are still stored and downloadable from the Marvelous Designer > [My Account](https://marvelousdesigner.com/mypage) page. ### 9) I have both CLO and Marvelous Designer IDs and I use them frequently. How does it affect me? You no longer have to use two separate logins! You can continue using your licenses without functional change for both CLO and Marvelous Designer. All you have to do is sign in with your CLO-SET account. You can check the license information for your products on the CLO or Marvelous Designer websites. ### 10) I like to use different email addresses for CLO and Marvelous Designer for my own reasons and want to keep them separate. Can I still have separate accounts? Yes, make sure to use the different email addresses for your CLO-SET merge so that you will have two separate CLO-SET accounts. The accounts are tied to each email address and the licenses associated with each account will be included in that merge. If you wish to unify your email addresses in the future or have other questions, please contact our support team at [support@clo-set.com](mailto:support@clo-set.com) or **[submit a request](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/requests/new)**. ### 11) I am using my software in an offline environment. Does this change affect me? Your access to your software will remain unaffected, you can continue using your pre-existing account user ID & password without change. If you choose to sign in to the websites for any of the CLO Virtual Fashion (CVF) products and services you will be prompted to merge your account into a CLO-SET account. Check out our detailed step-by-step guide **[HERE](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261721190041-Account-Merging-from-CLO-SET)**. ### 12) How do I change my password after I merge my accounts into a CLO-SET account? When you click 'Change Password' on the Marvelous Designer website or any CLO Virtual Fashion (CVF) product page, you will be redirected to the CLO-SET ‘[My Page](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount)’, where you can change your password. If you are already on the CLO-SET website, you can change the password under the settings tab on “[My page](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount)”. * If you are using a version of the software below 2024.0, your password for the software will not be synchronized with CLO-SET account. **See Question 13 if you want to change your password for an older version. ### 13) I'm using a version of Marvelous Designer that is below 2024.0 (Version 12,11,10, 9, etc). How do I change my password for my software login? * If you have integrated into the CLO-SET account: contact us via [the Marvelous Designer support team](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/requests/new). * If you don’t have an integrated CLO-SET account: reset your password via the [password reset page](https://marvelousdesigner.com/member/identify). ### 14) What happens to my subscription cycle if I change my account email? Changing your account email will NOT impact your subscription cycle or payment information. Please note that the email notifications on the renewal and payment confirmation will be sent to your original email registered at the point of subscription. ### 15) I have paid CLO-SET or CLO accounts, does this mean I get Marvelous Designer for free? No, the integration is only for login methods not purchasing and licensing. The paid CLO-SET and CLO services will remain separate from each other and require their own purchases for use. **If you need assistance regarding accounts merging or have questions, please contact us at******[**support@clo-set.com**](mailto:support@clo-set.com) **or[submit a request](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/requests/new), and our support team will promptly respond to your inquiry.**

title: User Pool Manual
content: ## **Description:** Userpool is the feature included in the License Account Admin page along with the launch of Marvelous Designer 2024.2 for those that are integrated with CLO-SET. Please read the page in the link below for more information on account integration. [(LINK to the page](https://landing.clo-set.com/allatonce)) Userpool enhances the experience of license management with multiple & single users and provides higher security around the license usage as well. The Userpool can be found and accessed at the left side of the menu bar inside of the [license account admin page](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/teamconsole). ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438167645209) ***IMPORTANT** In order to access the User Pool, you will need to have your Company ID integrated with CLO-SET as part of our optional One-Step login process. You will need to integrate your Company ID, and End User IDs (License IDs) under your company as well, with a valid working email address in order to operate the Userpool feature fully. Any users who are invited to accounts must be integrated with CLO-SET as well. ## **Offerings:** ### **[Userpool Settings]** **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438139894937)** **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438202253977)** * Userpool is set to be enabled as its default upon completing account integration. * From ‘Userpool Settings’, you can also choose to turn it off for a specific License ID if you wish not to share it. * Push the slide bar in order to disable userpool from certain License ID. * If the userpool gets turned off while the selected License ID is assigned with 1 or multiple members, they will be removed afterward. ### **[Add Members]** **:** How to add the members to Userpool? * By License Account admin (Website) **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438202459161)** **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438168278297)** * After clicking ‘Add Member’ button, the pop up window will appear * Choose certain License ID that you want to have assigned with members who are in needs of license usage * Type in a member's ID (email address) to assign. This also can be done with multiple number of member IDs at once. * Once the add member procedure is completed followed by the steps above, the member information will appear on the page, and the email will be sent for the verification on the member’s end. * By Software (Marvelous Designer) _*'Auto Add' option has to be on for this function_ **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438155478425)** **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438168763033)** * The end user logs-in to Marvelous Designer with License ID * Use ‘Sign in with CLO-SET account’ or ‘Switch CLO-SET Account’ feature * CLO-SET accounts that are logged-in via software followed by above step, will be automatically added into Userpool ### **[Auto Add]** **:** What is Auto Add? * After the log-in to Marvelous Designer by License ID and signing in with a CLO-SET account inside of the Software (Sign in with CLO-SET, Switch CLO-SET Account), the CLO-SET Email is automatically added to the user pool of the corresponding License ID. _(Process)_ * Log in to Marvelous Designer with License ID ‘A’, and sign in with a CLO-SET account ‘B’ * This CLO-SET account ‘B’ will be added to user pool, underneath the License ID ‘A’ * If you switch the account to different CLO-SET account while using the software, then it will also be added to user pool, underneath the License ID ‘A’ * This option can be turned off at the License Account Admin - Userpool page. * ‘Auto Add’ option is only available for Onlineauth type of license. * ‘Auto Add’ will only work with License ID that has the email address attached. * If you try to assign members via ‘Auto Add’ option to the License ID that does not have an eligible email address attached, it will not function properly. ### **[Send Installer/ Delete]** ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438168906009) ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438156039705) * If you need to send out the installer for a certain version, or to make sure the end user received it well on their side, use the ‘Send Installer’ button. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438203487001) * Also, the delete of member ID is available by clicking on the ‘Delete’ button * If a member is using more than one License ID, then you can choose License IDs you want to delete the member from. ### **[Name Edit]** **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438219288217)** * You can assign nicknames to members for efficient management. This helps distinguish between members and take accurate actions. Use member names to simplify team management. ***ACCOUNT STATUS** * Not Integrated / Company blocked CLO-SET account Integration **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438203817497)** * Not Integrated/ Company allowed CLO-SET account integration **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438156861081)** * Integrated with CLO-SET **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438204151961)** * Integrated (End User with Standalone License and have Sub Account(Member)) **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438190725657)** ### **Offering by License Type:** * The Userpool feature allows you to manage access to your software license. Its functionality varies depending on your license type. ### [Network Online Licenses (Academic, Enterprise) and Linux License] * Adding Members: With these licenses, you can add an unlimited number of members to your Userpool using the "Add Member" feature. * Concurrent Users: While you can add as many members as you need, the number of users who can log in and use the software at the same time is limited by the number of licenses you own. ***Note:** If the number of concurrent users exceeds your license limit, users will not be able to log in. * Platform Restriction for Linux License: A member added for a Linux license can only use the software on the Linux OS. They will be unable to log in on Mac or Windows operating systems. *Note: If a Linux license member attempts to log in on an incompatible OS, an error will occur. ### [Enterprise Standalone, Personal, and Student Licenses] * Adding a Member: These licenses are limited to a single concurrent user, so you can only add one additional member using the "Add Member" feature. *Important: If you add a new Member, it will automatically replace and delete the previous one. * Concurrent Users: The concurrent user count for these licenses is one. This means that only one user, either the main account or the added Member, can be logged in at a time. * Note: The Standalone License will be retired as of December 2, 2025.
